title: docs(spec): Seed.locale says which loads filter on it, and the ownership-queue contract says the registered service honours onFailedRead refuse
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTqqeHSwZYJmApbDCa

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKB8Sg6c6sVpL96ruVvdxaf)_

Fixes #30347
Fixes #30389

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 只改 `@objectstack/spec` 的两处说明文字，不改任何代码或 schema 形状。① `Seed.locale` 的说明不再说"安装不按语种挑"：现在写明启动种子按应用的 `i18n.defaultLocale`；市场安装、重灌示例数据、重启自愈、按组织回放按"组织设置 → 安装/创建人语言 → 应用默认"挑；包应用和草稿发布仍不挑。② 队列服务契约不再说"注册的服务还不支持 `'refuse'`"，写明激活台账读失败仍按"开启"是已定的决定，并写明 `isMember` 在 `'refuse'` 下何时答 `true`、何时拒绝。
- **为什么改：** PR #30346 和 PR #30386 合并后，这几句已发布的说明与运行时行为不符，作者照着读会得出错误结论。
- **风险与回滚：** 只动 TSDoc、`.describe()` 文案和由它生成的四个参考页，运行时零变化。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`（`locale` 的说明，三级取值那一段）；`packages/spec/src/contracts/ownership-queue-service.ts`（`isMember` 文档新增的四句）。
- **两分钟验证：** `git grep -n "do not filter by locale" content/docs/references packages/spec/src`，预期每处命中都是"package apply and draft publish do not filter by locale"，不再有"The publish and install paths"。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

Wording only, in one package (`@objectstack/spec`, `patch`). Each new sentence below names the line on `origin/main` (`ffeda137b`, merged into this branch in round 2) it rests on.

### #30347: `SeedSchema.locale` (`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`)

**Before (docblock):** "Publishing and installing are locale-neutral acts — this axis is scoped to the boot path, by decision. … `SeedLoaderConfig.locale`, which only the boot path supplies … Package apply, draft publish and marketplace install each build their own load request and pass no locale …"

**Before (`.describe()`):** "The publish and install paths do not filter by locale — they load every dataset and warn"

**After:** the docblock paragraph becomes three bullets, and the `.describe()` says the same in one sentence. Round 1 (contract review should-fix 1 and 2) names the reseeding user in the `.describe()` and says what rung 1 reads for a load that names no organization.

| New sentence | Rests on |
|---|---|
| A request with no locale loads a `locale`-scoped dataset for every locale, and the loader warns | `packages/runtime/src/seed-locale.ts:30-32` (no rung ⇒ `undefined`, `warnOnUnresolvedLocaleScope`); `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:5305-5307` (spread, never `locale: undefined`) |
| The boot seed and the dev hot-reload seeder filter on the app's `i18n.defaultLocale` | `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:1937` (boot) and `:2367` (hot reload), both `this.resolveSeedLocale()`, which reads `i18n.defaultLocale` at `:2299-2303` |
| Install, reseed, heal and per-organization replay filter on what `resolveSeedLocaleForLoad` resolves | its four callers: `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:5239-5242` (`applySideEffects`, reached by install `:2537` and reseed `:4376`), `:1465` (restart heal), `:1728` (that plugin's own replayer); `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:1825-1830` (the AppPlugin per-organization replayer). All four go through `runInlineSeed` (`:5287-5292`) or call the producer directly |
| Rung 1: the `localization.locale` setting for the organization, only when `source` is not `'default'` | `seed-locale.ts:135-140` |
| Rung 1, a load that names no organization (a single-tenant install or reseed, the restart heal) still reads the setting: the environment override answers first, then the `global` setting, then, where no wall stands and the deployment holds exactly one organization, that organization's own setting | `seed-locale.ts:137` (`settings.get('localization', 'locale', {})` when no organization is named); `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts:1951-1966` (the env override answers before any row is read), `:2119` and `:2175` (the cascade order global, tenant, default, first non-null wins), `:2137-2149` (the tenant rung, read for a tenant-scoped key: `localization` is `scope: 'tenant'`, `manifests/localization.manifest.ts:39`); `settings-service.ts:2221-2227` (`organizationReachOf` hands an organization-less caller to `resolveOrganizationReach`), `packages/core/src/security/organization-reach.ts:87-95` (no wall ⇒ the derived organization becomes the reach), `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:1676-1696` (`resolveGuestOrganization`) and `packages/core/src/security/system-write-organization.ts:115-124` (`single` posture and exactly one `sys_organization` ⇒ `derived`); the heal passes no organization (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:1465`) |
| Rung 2: `sys_user.locale` of the user who installs, reseeds or founds, when one started the load (the `.describe()` now says "the installing, reseeding or founding user") | `seed-locale.ts:142-153`; install passes `admission.userId` (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:1744` to `:2537` to `:5239-5241`), reseed passes the reseeding user's `admission.userId` (`:4376` to `:5239-5241`), the heal passes no user (`:1462-1465`) |
| Rung 3: the app's `i18n.defaultLocale`, when the caller names one | `seed-locale.ts:128-129, 155`; the marketplace plugin's own replayer passes none (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:1723-1728`) |
| A setting or user read that fails seeds nothing rather than another language | `seed-locale.ts:34-39` (the throw reaches the caller, which writes nothing) |
| Package apply and draft publish pass no locale | `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:4000-4007` and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts:115-125`: neither request carries `locale` |
| The #17011 bound is narrowed to those two paths by the maintainer's ruling (2026-11-05) | `seed-locale.ts:7-9` ("maintainer ruling A, 2026-11-05 … reversing the install-path bound recorded on `SeedSchema.locale`") |

The `.describe()` change regenerates four references pages, all committed: `content/docs/references/data/seed.mdx`, `data/seed-loader.mdx`, `api/package-api.mdx`, `kernel/manifest.mdx`.

### #30389: `packages/spec/src/contracts/ownership-queue-service.ts`

1. **Before:** "the registered one, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`'s, honours `'refuse'` from #29604's code half on, so until then a caller passing `'refuse'` still gets `'nobody'`." **After:** "the registered one, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`'s, honours `'refuse'`." Rests on `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/ownership-queue-service.ts:270-279` (`expandMembers`) and `:290-297` (`isMember`), which take `onFailedRead` and wrap a failure in `queueReadRefusal` (`:168`).
2. **Before:** "whether that posture moves is #29604's code half to decide." **After:** "That posture stays by decision: it is the one the sharing-rule service takes for the same ledger on its own `position` recipients, so a queue's position and a rule's position cannot disagree during an outage." Rests on `ownership-queue-service.ts:670-688` (`switchedOff` catches the ledger read and returns nothing switched off, under either answer) and `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts`, `readPositionActive` (a failed ledger read answers active).
3. **Added to `isMember`'s doc:** "Under `'refuse'` the registered service reads the queue's own rows (`sys_queue`, `sys_queue_member`) first, and a failure there rejects at once, since without them the queue's member set would be incomplete (a declared queue's own specifications come from the registry, but its authored additions come from `sys_queue_member`). Past them it answers `true` as soon as a read that succeeded reaches `userId`, even beside a failed read, and rejects only when no successful read reaches `userId` and one failed." Rests on `ownership-queue-service.ts:232-261` (`resolve` reads `authoredQueueRow` and `authoredMemberSpecs` with `refuse` before any specification; a declared queue's specifications come from `declaredMemberSpecs` at `:243`, its authored additions from `authoredMemberSpecs` at `:237`) and `:476-496` (`specsReachUser`: returns `true` on the first reaching spec, keeps the first failure, throws it only after the walk). Round 1 (contract review should-fix 3) replaced the earlier reason, "since without them the call does not know what to ask", which overstated it for a declared queue.

Left as it was, because it is true: the `'nobody'` bullet still says the admission consumers (D3, D4, D5) take `'nobody'`. Measured: `sharing-service.ts:952`, `security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts:1610` and `objectql/src/assignment-rules.ts:293` call without the option; only D6 (`approval-service.ts:3541`) and D7 (`sharing-rule-service.ts:1752`, `:2198`) pass `'refuse'`.

## Tests

No behaviour changed, so no new test. Round 2 readings were taken on head `d0863ab93` (after merging `origin/main` `ffeda137b`).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data/seed.test.ts src/data/seed-loader.test.ts src/data/seed-file.zod.test.ts src/data/define-seed-record-keys.test.ts`: 4 files, 111 tests passed (the spec tests that touch `seed.zod.ts`; round 2 changes no other file's source).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, then `gen:docs`, then `check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0, 0 errors.
- eslint on `seed.zod.ts`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event` (this body as a `pull_request` event): exit 0, "a non-protocol change at `patch`".
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 96 commands, run after a full `turbo run build` (119/119), all exit 0, exit codes recorded before any pipe. `--ran`: "96 derived, 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".

## Acceptance notes

- **The dispatch's reading of #30389 sentence 2 was wider than the code.** "Whether that posture moves" names the activation-ledger read posture, not the admission consumers' answer. PR #30386 kept the ledger posture ("switched on" on a failed read). The new sentence says that. The admission consumers' `'nobody'` was already stated and still holds (see above).
- **`isMember` under `'refuse'` does not answer `true` beside every failed read.** A failed `sys_queue` or `sys_queue_member` read rejects before any specification is read, even for a declared queue whose positions might reach the user (PR #30386's acceptance notes say the same). The doc says so, so that "rejects only when no successful read reaches the user" is not read as covering the queue's own rows.
- **One more published sentence turned false by PR #30346, outside this PR's file surface.** The `locale` row note in `packages/spec/liveness/seed.json` still says the marketplace install passes no locale and calls publish and install locale-neutral. Same defect class; not touched here because the claim covers only `seed.zod.ts`, `ownership-queue-service.ts`, the regenerated pages and one changeset, and the note is a long ruling record, not a mechanical edit. Reported to the seat.
- **Card #30347 has two commits, not one.** The regenerated references pages and the changeset went in a second commit (`9ba263492`) after the source commit (`3bbc3eb9b`), because a force-push to fold them in was refused in this session. #30389 is the third commit (`9d61fa4aa`).
- **Round 1.** The contract review (PASS, no must-fix) listed three should-fix wording items; all three are in this PR: `d56c29454` (#30347, rung 1 and the reseeding user), `d0db2c6a9` (#30389, the `isMember` reason), `8629666d9` (the four regenerated references pages). The liveness-note finding is filed separately as #30607. `origin/main` was merged in first (`871582d63`); the moved citations (`packages.ts`, `approval-service.ts`) are updated above.
- **Round 2.** The delta review at `8629666d9` (PASS, one should-fix) found rung 1's organization-less parenthetical read as exhaustive while missing a third source, the deployment's one organization's own row. `d0863ab93` adds it to the docblock; the `.describe()` and the changeset are unchanged (their wording stays true). `origin/main` `ffeda137b` was merged first (`e2f2e2175`), and `15456e098` regenerates `package-api.mdx` after that merge (its only difference from `origin/main` is the two `locale` rows). The marketplace plugin moved in that merge, so its line citations above are re-measured.
- `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` still carries the released "publish and install paths do not filter by locale" entry. It is release-owned and correct for the release that shipped it; not edited.
